content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is an adjudicated bundling denial, so resubmitting the unchanged claim risks another denial and there is no identified claim-data error to correct. A formal appeal is permitted with the denial on file, and similar claims succeeded more often with appeal (3/8) than peer-to-peer review (1/5); the available documentation is reasonably strong for supporting separate medical necessity.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
